title: Diabetic retinopathy screening review

user_facing_items.final_wording: Supports recording eligibility, attendance, prior pathway status, information sharing and coordination with primary care, diabetology, hospital eye and maternity services.
user_facing_items.population: People eligible for the NHS diabetic eye screening programme, including pathway-specific pregnancy and surveillance groups.
user_facing_items.setting: End-to-end diabetic eye screening, grading, result communication, surveillance and referral pathways.
restrictions: Exact for selected screening-result, visual-acuity, image-grading, result-letter, surveillance and referral-status documentation. It does not independently interpret an individual result or apply directly to UAE screening intervals.
user_facing_items.rationale: Supports eligibility, attendance and pathway coordination for diabetic eye screening review; no decision is generated.
